notes.title: Devlog Patch Update for Not It: Spookiest Edition
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

We've made a small patch to Not It: Spookiest Edition as we come up on the first year anniversary! These patches are to fix some issues we found.

A few things we've fixed:
-Fixed a bug with incorrect sprites display
-Fixed a bug with incorrect name displayed typos
-Fixed a bug when clicking to progress wasn't working
-Removed the animated logo that is displayed after every ending (the logo will only show once when the game starts)
-Removed the gore setting that displayed after every ending (you can find it in the settings menu)

If you run into any problems with the patch or come across any additional bugs, let us know!

Thank you!

notes.title: Not It: Spookiest Edition Release & Bookmarks
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

It's been a little over a week since we released Not It: Spookiest Edition on October 12th! We've been so excited about the game's reception, and that we finally got to share the game with everyone.

To celebrate the release, we're continuing our tradition of making special DIY bookmarks for the characters. We've provided instructions for printing along with the bookmark assets here. Let us know what you think of the finished product!

If you haven't already, make sure you grab your copy of Not It: Spookiest Edition for a ~spoooky~ Halloween!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1719770/Not_It_Spookiest_Edition/

Thank you as always for your continued support throughout Not It: Spookiest Edition! Make sure to follow us on Twitter to get our frequent updates on future visual novels, and when our games will be on sale!

notes.title: Not It: Spookiest Edition Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone~

We've put out a small patch to Not It: Spookiest Edition! Learn about what we've fixed/updated:


Joseph will be more active during one of the action sequences.
Joseph won't exist in two places at once after hiding in the closet (otherwise known as "Ghost Joseph.")
There was one line where the cast was unexpectedly silent but that is no longer the case.
Katie's new haircut is now on display in one of the ending artworks (it will remain unlocked if you unlocked it previously).
Some players using newer Mac computers (M1/Apple Silicone) were having issues launching the game. This has been fixed.
